reel.name: reel-1-think-about-it
reel.caption:
Your leads don't need to "think about it." They need a reason to trust you before the call.

Most coaches try to fix this with better scripts. Better objection handling. Better closing lines.

That's not the problem. The problem is there's no value built before the conversation.

Fix the trust. The sales fix themselves.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

Follow for more.

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

carousel.name: carousel-1-discipline-battery
carousel.caption:
You keep crashing every few weeks and calling it burnout.

It's not burnout. It's a dead battery with no recharge plan.

After studying nearly 200 online fitness coaches, I noticed the ones who last aren't the ones who go hardest. They're the ones who planned when to stop.

Plan your rest like you plan your training.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

-Dani Gomez

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

reel.name: reel-2-80-percent-quit
reel.caption:
80% of online fitness coaches quit in year one. Not because they're bad coaches. Because they have no system.

No predictable way to get clients. No structure. Just posting, hoping, waiting.

You're still here looking for answers. That's the difference.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

Follow for more.

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

carousel.name: carousel-2-coach-vs-business-owner
carousel.caption:
You became a coach because you're great at coaching.

But running a business is a different skill.

After studying nearly 200 online fitness coaches, these 6 signs showed up over and over in the coaches who were stuck.

The shift isn't about coaching less. It's about building systems around your coaching.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

-Dani Gomez

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

reel.name: reel-3-lead-problem
reel.caption:
47 inquiries. Zero clients. Same month, same niche, another coach had 11 inquiries and signed 4.

The difference wasn't the leads. It was the system. One had predictable steps. The other had a messy inbox and hope.

More leads will not fix a broken system.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

Follow for more.

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

carousel.name: carousel-3-free-coaching
carousel.caption:
"Just coach for free until you get testimonials."

I keep hearing this advice everywhere. And I keep seeing it fail.

One coach did everything right -- cold outreach, VAs, a marketing agency, free coaching -- for two years. Zero paying clients.

Free coaching doesn't fix a differentiation problem. It hides it.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

-Dani Gomez

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

reel.name: reel-4-starting-from-zero
reel.caption:
84% of clients in this industry come from referrals. No system. Just luck.

That's why every month feels like starting from zero. One slow week and everything stops.

You need 3 systems: lead flow, nurture, and sales. Predictable steps that result in a predictable outcome.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

Follow for more.

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

carousel.name: carousel-4-saturated
carousel.caption:
"The space is saturated."

I hear this every single day from online fitness coaches. And they're right -- the bottom IS crowded.

But a $34 billion market growing at 28% per year is not saturated at the top. The coaches who have a clear niche, a real voice, and a system are almost impossible to find.

Stop competing with everyone. Start being for someone.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

-Dani Gomez

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

reel.name: reel-5-feel-like-a-fraud
reel.caption:
You feel like a fraud because coaches with half your knowledge are doing better.

They're not better coaches. They're more visible. They show up. They post. They put themselves out there.

Invisible credibility pays zero. The more people know you exist, the less you'll feel like an impostor.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

Follow for more.

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

carousel.name: carousel-5-47k-trap
carousel.caption:
$47,000 a year. Only 28% full-time.

Those are the real numbers behind the fitness coaching industry.

Not because coaches aren't talented. Because they were never taught the business side.

Program design is a skill. Getting clients is also a skill. The coaches who treat it that way don't stay at $47K.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

-Dani Gomez

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

reel.name: reel-6-not-burned-out
reel.caption:
You're not burned out. You're doing the work of 5 people with zero systems.

Trainer. Marketer. Tech support. Admin. Salesperson. Every day. All of them. None done well.

Rest won't fix that. A system will. Predictable steps that result in a predictable outcome.

Build the system. The burnout disappears.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

Follow for more.

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

carousel.name: carousel-6-client-systems
carousel.caption:
Your clients shouldn't have to chase you for basic information.

"When do I check in?" "How do I contact you?" "Can I see my progress?"

Every one of those questions is a system you haven't built.

After studying nearly 200 online fitness coaches, the ones who retained clients the longest weren't the best programmers. They had the best systems.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

-Dani Gomez

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

reel.name: reel-7-nobody-will-see-this
reel.caption:
You posted. 20 views. And now you want to quit.

There are 8 billion people on Earth. 1% of that is 80 million. You're not saturated. You're invisible. And invisible is fixable.

Keep posting. You get better. More people find you. It compounds.

It takes reps.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

Follow for more.

#onlinefitnesscoach #onlinefitnesscoaches

carousel.name: carousel-7-half-my-knowledge
carousel.caption:
"People with half my knowledge are doing better than me."

I hear this from online fitness coaches constantly. And they're always right.

The difference is never knowledge. It's visibility.

The coach with half your skills but twice your visibility will make more money every single time. That's not unfair. That's a skill gap you can fix.

(Disclaimer: This is based on what I've observed; results are not guaranteed!)

-Dani Gomez
